dogecoin.text: Where was #Doge when I had the runny nose? No clothes, no dough, no chicks with pretty toes... #DogeCoin 🚀🚀🚀🚀

Binance will list three new coins: Neiro (NEIRO), Turbo (TURBO), and Baby Doge Coin (100000BABYDOGE). These memecoins run on the Ethereum network and are viewed as the next generation of Dogecoin, inspired by Neiro, the new Shiba Inu dog from Atsuko Sato.
